_readme: Where to put example pictures that the automatic placement gets wrong. placeFigure: figure file -> rule id (from the rule page link #/rule/<id>). The picture is added at the end of that rule. Figure files are in site/figures/ (named <doc>-p<page>-<n>.webp).
_readme2: Used by tools/extract_figures.py (re-run it after editing): dropFigure = picture files that aren't real figures (cover art, copyright footer); figureBox = file -> [x0, y0, x1, y1] crop in PDF points, for when the automatic crop catches stray text. dropLabel (used by build_data.py) = document id -> label texts printed inside a picture that shouldn't also appear as paragraphs.
